# Zoho Recruit | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Enterprise recruitment | The main link to validate the enterprise's recruitment is “entry of personnel or candidate data - rules or approval processing - self-help of staff managers - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Client and candidate management of recruitment agencies | Main link management of recruitment agency clients and candidates is used as “entry of personnel or candidate data - rules or approval processing - self-help of staff managers - results into reports or downstream systems”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| High-volume positions | High-volume posts are certified on the main link with “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - staff manager self-help - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Zoho package user recruitment process | Validate the Zoho package recruitment process as the main link for "People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - results into reports or downstream systems". It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
